port.label: Server Port
port.description: Port number for the MusicFree Subsonic API server (default: 4533).

token.label: API Token
token.description: API token for client authentication (used as X-API-Key or JWT secret). Leave empty to auto-generate.

search_scope.label: Search Scope
search_scope.description: Comma-separated list of provider domains to search (e.g. 'spotify,local'). Leave empty for all.

manifest.description: OpenSubsonic API bridge for MusicFree clients - browse and stream all MA music sources via the Subsonic protocol.
